differences.what: The porch: the vignette's flat roof and the railed deck under it run on from the door across the whole front, past the panel's right edge; the build's portico and deck stop at the bowed bay's north foot, 2.95 m across. K01 lays a door hood beside a bay, not before it (liberty L-k01-2035-stone-3661).

The bay: the sheet's full-height bowed stone bay at the front's south end shows in the render; the vignette shows no bay, its principal storey behind the deck and porch roof, its upper part cut by the frame and a street tree. The 1911 sheet and the census ('a full-height bay') are held over the freehand sketch; a bay rising behind the porch roof is consistent with what the sketch leaves visible.
The portico's top: the vignette draws a plain flat top over a deep entablature; K01's hood carries a railing or a pediment, so it wears the kit's lowest railing, 0.35 m.
The deck's railing: the vignette's band of scrolls between the stoop's right cheek and the panel's edge; the build's pierced stone parapet with two holes, 1.05 m long.

The door: a round-arched opening with a fanlight at the head of the stoop, at the north end of the front, as drawn; its width against the porch is the sketch's proportion, about 1.25 times wider than the record's heights allow (the camera's pixel aspect).

The stoop: the vignette's swept cheeks flaring to the walk, the left the wider, and a flight drawn longer than a 1.7 m floor gives (its foot at y 261 against the camera's 220); built as K07's swept cheeks with newels. The fence hides the flight in the render.

The light over the porch roof: a tall round-headed light, drawn about 1.5 m south of the door's axis; built over the door's axis under a round head and key. The sketch's horizontal placing is not reliable to that margin.

The fence: the vignette's low railing on a curb either side of the stoop and a capped post at the stoop's foot; built as K11's spear fence on a curb with a walk gate on iron posts, about 0.3 m taller.
Colour and the stone's tone: a monochrome pen sketch.
The cornice, the upper storeys' heights, the 21st Street flank and the rear: outside the panel or under its numerals' cartouche.

_how: verdict is unreviewed | differs | matches, set by whoever compared the side-by-side with the picture; each difference is {what, status: open | fixed | not shown | within tolerance | owner ruling} — open only if a street visitor would notice it (over about 1 ft, missing, mis-shaped, miscounted, wrong material or colour), else within tolerance (T-3153); owner ruling where the owner asked the build to depart from the picture (T-3236). A ticket whose ## Image gate names this building does not close while it is not "matches" (tools/image_gate.mjs).
